test_index_col_named: test read_csv with named index_col parameter to set a column as the DataFrame index
test_index_col_named2: test read_csv with names and index_col list to assign custom column names and index
test_index_col_is_true: test read_csv raises ValueError when index_col is set to boolean True
test_infer_index_col: test read_csv automatically infers the first column as index when no index_col is specified
test_index_col_empty_data: test read_csv with various index_col values on header-only CSV with no data rows
test_multi_index_naming: test read_csv with multi-level index_col preserves custom index level names including empty strings
test_header_with_index_col: test read_csv with multi-row header and index_col to build MultiIndex columns
test_index_col_large_csv: test read_csv with index_col on a large CSV file for performance
test_index_col_multiindex_columns_no_dat: test read_csv with multiindex columns and index_col on empty data
test_specify_dtype_for_index_col: test read_csv with dtype parameter to control index column data type
